mapper.select: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.line_total_amount) DESC) as rank, b.name as branchName, SUM(om.line_total_amount) as totalSales FROM orders o JOIN branch b ON o.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY totalSales DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC) as rank, b.name as branchName, SUM(om.qty) as totalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN branch b ON o.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.line_total_amount) DESC) as rank, r.name as menuName, SUM(om.line_total_amount) as totalSales FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id JOIN recipe r ON om.recipe_code = r.recipe_code WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY totalSales DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC) as rank, r.name as menuName, SUM(om.qty) as totalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id JOIN recipe r ON om.recipe_code = r.recipe_code WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.line_total_amount) DESC) as rank, b.name as branchName, SUM(om.line_total_amount) as totalSales FROM orders o JOIN branch b ON o.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND om.recipe_code = #{recipeCode} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY totalSales DESC

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC) as rank, b.name as branchName, SUM(om.qty) as totalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN branch b ON o.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND om.recipe_code = #{recipeCode} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC
SELECT category_id as categoryCode, name as categoryName FROM main_category WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY category_id
SELECT recipe_code as recipeCode, name as recipeName, category_id as categoryCode FROM recipe WHERE category_id = #{categoryCode} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY name

SELECT HOUR(o.created_at) as hour, SUM(om.line_total_amount) as totalSales, SUM(om.qty) as totalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(o.order_date) as dayOfWeek, CASE DAYOFWEEK(o.order_date) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END as dayName, SUM(om.line_total_amount) as totalSales, SUM(om.qty) as totalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY dayOfWeek, dayName ORDER BY dayOfWeek
